strategy.name: Qullamaggie Breakout
sources: Kristjan Kullamägi (@Qullamaggie-fkdave) — Qullamaggie Swing Trading School
strategy.description: Strong prior momentum move, pullback to rising SMA10/20/50, higher lows, tight consolidation range, then breakout above the range on volume. SMA10 is the trailing stop. Market bias filter (SMA10 above SMA20, both rising) is required before any long entry.

indicators.sma_10: Short-term trend and primary trailing stop. Strongest stocks surf the SMA10. First 4H close below SMA10 = exit remaining position.
indicators.sma_20: Medium-term support. Most setups consolidate surfing the SMA20. SMA10 must be above SMA20 for bullish bias.
indicators.sma_50: Deeper pullback support. Valid for entries when price bounces cleanly off SMA50 after a big prior move.
indicators.atr_14: Volatility. Stop distance (entry to consolidation low) must not exceed 1 ATR. Most important entry filter.
indicators.volume: Breakout confirmation. Breakout candle volume should be above the 20-period average.

bullish: SMA10 is rising (current value greater than value 3 bars ago)
SMA20 is rising (current value greater than value 3 bars ago)
bearish: SMA20 is declining — avoid swing longs, high fail rate
neutral: SMA10 and SMA20 are flat or mixed — reduced edge, be more selective

long: Market bias is bullish — SMA10 above SMA20, both rising
Price made a significant prior move up (momentum phase — large directional run)
Price pulled back or consolidated sideways after the move (at least 5 candles of base-building)
Price found support on SMA10, SMA20, or SMA50 during consolidation — 'surfing' the moving average
Price is forming higher lows during the consolidation (each pullback stops higher than the last)
Consolidation range is tightening — recent candles are visibly smaller and narrower
Current candle breaks out above the multi-candle consolidation range high
Volume on breakout candle is at or above the 20-period average volume
Distance from entry price to consolidation range low does not exceed 1 ATR14 — stop is within range

exit_rules: Initial stop: low of the entry candle (or consolidation range low, whichever is closer)
After 3-5 candles of profitable movement: sell 1/3 to 1/2 of position to lock in gains
After partial exit: move remaining stop to break-even
Trailing stop on remaining position: first 4H candle close below SMA10 = exit all remaining
If price closes back inside the consolidation range on the entry candle or next candle: exit immediately
risk_rules: Stop loss must not exceed 1 ATR14 from entry — if it does, skip the trade
Maximum single trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD in .env (set to $100)
Maximum 3 trades per day — capped by MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY in .env
Do not trade longs when market bias is bearish (SMA10 below SMA20, both declining)
Win rate will be 25-35% — small frequent losses are expected and normal
Aim for 5x-20x initial risk on winners — let them run with SMA10 trailing stop
notes: Adapted from Qullamaggie's daily equity momentum strategy to 4H BTCUSDT. Core principle is identical: find a momentum move, wait for tight consolidation above rising MAs with higher lows, enter the range breakout. SMA10 is the key trailing stop tool — do not exit early if price holds it. Paper trade first.
